newsitem.title: CANADA: Onex unit to acquire UK manufacturer.
newsitem.headline: Onex unit to acquire UK manufacturer.

text.p: Onex Corp said on Tuesday its Celestica subsidiary agreed to acquire the assets and operations of Design to Distribution Ltd from ICL Plc, which is 90 percent-owned by Fujitsu Ltd and 10 percent by Northern Telecom Ltd.
Financial details of the deal were not disclosed.

Design to Distribution is the largest European-based participant in the electronic manufacturing services industry, with annual revenues of about US$560 million and assets of US$180 million, Onex said.
Onex said Design to Distribution represented an ideal platform for Celestica into Britain and Europe, with 2,500 employees and several manufacturing locations in England.

Financing for the acquisition will be provided partly by Celestica, from its available cash resources specifically set aside for such purposes, and some portion through bank financing by Design to Distribution in the United Kingdom.
